title: MCAROC data coverage catalogue
purpose: Every data element of the two MCA/ROC workbooks, mapped to: the parser + entity that ingests it, whether it is parsed today, and where it surfaces on the portal and in the client dossier. The contract for 'no Excel data is missed'. Codex/Antigravity work against this file; a field with status != 'live' is a task.

status_legend.live: parsed into an entity AND rendered on the portal

status_legend.shown-partial: some columns of this block reach the portal, others are dropped
status_legend.not-parsed: no parser reads this; data is only in Layer-0 SourceRow

gaps.title: Company identity & contact block not captured
gaps.detail: About-the-Company dropped: business address, website, 3 emails (+ reachability marker), phone, the narrative paragraph, type of entity, listing status, date of last AGM, LEI + status, segment, MCA 'Sum of Charges'. (The source-export timestamp rows are dropped by design — see the sheet entry.)
gaps.fix: CompanyProfile gained EntityType / ListingStatus / Website / Phone / NarrativeDescription / Lei / LeiStatus / Segment / BusinessAddress / RegisteredAddress{City,State,PinCode} / LastAgmDate / McaSumOfChargesCrore; new CompanyEmail entity (with IsReachable). CompanyProfileParser rewritten; migration AddCompanyIdentityAndContact; rendered on the Corporate tab overview.

gaps.title: Full shareholding-pattern category grid dropped
gaps.detail: Structure sheet's PROMOTERS and PUBLIC grids (SEBI categories x {equity shares, equity %, preference shares, preference %}) were not parsed — only the 6-field summary was kept.
gaps.fix: New ShareholdingPatternRow entity (HolderClass Promoter|Public, Category, CategoryGroup, AsOnDate, DisplayOrder, EquityShares, EquityPercent, PreferenceShares, PreferencePercent); StructureParser extended with a second out-param; migration AddShareholdingPattern; rendered as per-class tables on the Corporate tab Ownership section. Dossier Annexure-A item still pending (Wave 4).

gaps.title: Name history not captured
gaps.detail: Highlights sheet 'NAME HISTORY' (former name + till-date) was dropped.
gaps.fix: New CompanyNameHistory entity + HighlightsParser.ParseNameHistory; migration AddNameHistoryAndPba; table on the Corporate tab Overview.

gaps.title: Principal Business Activities structured table dropped
gaps.detail: Highlights 'PRINCIPAL BUSINESS ACTIVITIES' (main activity group code + desc, business activity code + desc, % of turnover) collapsed to a string.
gaps.fix: New PrincipalBusinessActivity entity + HighlightsParser.ParsePrincipalBusinessActivities (multi-row); table on the Corporate tab Overview.

gaps.title: 5 Closest Peers by Revenue not captured
gaps.detail: Peer Comparison sheet's closest-peers list (legal name, CIN, city, revenue) was dropped.
gaps.fix: New PeerCompany entity (LegalName / Cin / City / RevenueCrore / Rank / FinancialYear + Industry/Segment); PeerComparisonParser gains a second out-param; migration AddPeerCompanies; rendered as a 'Closest Peers by Revenue' table on the Financials tab (self row highlighted). Bar-chart viz is Wave 3.

gaps.title: EPFO establishment metadata dropped
gaps.detail: EPFO Establishments sheet drops per-establishment City, Date of Setup, Principal Business Activities, Address, Exemption Status, Flags — only monthly contributions are kept.
gaps.fix: New EpfoEstablishment entity (establishmentId, name, city, dateOfSetup, principalBusinessActivities, address, exemptionStatus, workingStatus, flags, latestWageMonth) + EpfoParser.ParseEstablishments; migration AddEpfoEstablishment; per-establishment profile fields on the Compliance-tab establishment cards + a Snapshot count in the dossier.

gaps.title: Parsed-but-not-(fully)-shown: FinancialFacts, FinancialParameters, CompanyOfficers, CashFlowYearInferred
gaps.detail: 462 FinancialFacts, 23 FinancialParameters, 3 CompanyOfficers and the CashFlowYearInferred flag are ingested but the portal tabs may not render them fully. Audit each tab and wire the missing renders.
gaps.fix: Per-tab render audit (Corporate: officers; Financials: full statement incl. facts + ratios + parameters + inferred-year caption). Confirmed already done: FinancialStatementBuilder appends unmapped facts (not just the ~25 typed fields), the Ratios sub-tab and Additional Indicators table both render, the Cash Flow Year Alignment banner + asterisk badges are in _FinancialStatement.cshtml, and CompanyOfficers has its own 'Key Managerial Personnel' table on Corporate → Management.

gaps.title: Shareholding entity drops columns
gaps.detail: Director Shareholding drops Designation + Cessation Date; Shareholding >5% drops Relationship, Country/City, PUC/Obligation, Sum of Charges, Date of Incorp, Status, Active Compliance, Remarks.
gaps.fix: Extend Shareholding entity + parser to carry the full column set.

gaps.title: Minor column drops (RelatedCorporate, GstRegistration)
gaps.detail: RelatedCorporate: Active Compliance, Remarks. GstRegistration: Centre Jurisdiction, State Jurisdiction, Legal Name of Business.
gaps.fix: Add the fields to the entities + parsers.

gaps.title: Auditor firm identity not structured
gaps.detail: 'Comments Given By' (auditor name, membership number, firm name, firm registration number) folded into AuditorObservation.AuditorName string.
gaps.fix: Split into AuditorName / MembershipNumber / FirmName / FirmRegistrationNumber.

gaps.title: Litigation Uncertain (Unverified Court Records) has no UI cue
gaps.detail: PR #29 routes 'Unverified Court Records' rows to MatchStatus=Uncertain, but the Litigation tab shows them under category 'Other' with no 'unverified — verify against source' banner. the benchmark tool gives Probable + Unverified their own sections with a plain-English disclaimer.
gaps.fix: Litigation tab (Track B): split Confirmed / Probable / Unverified into separate sub-sections, each with a disclaimer. Done: _LitigationTab.cshtml has a dedicated Unverified sub-tab with a 'Provisional Court Records' banner — the sheet's own field row already noted this (B3/#41) but the gap itself was never marked done. Confirmed still true by render audit 2026-09-12.

gaps.title: EPFO TRRN dropped
gaps.detail: Transaction reference number on the monthly EPFO annexure not stored.
gaps.fix: Added EpfoContribution.Trrn (migration AddEpfoEstablishment).

gaps.title: Related Party Transactions sheet not parsed
gaps.detail: Transaction-level RPT disclosure (party x transaction type x FY, with amount) — 25/41 companies in the wider portfolio set. Distinct from Related Corporates.
gaps.fix: New RelatedPartyTransaction entity + parser (flat 6-col table, header row 1) + Corporate-tab render.

gaps.title: Credit Ratings + Unaccepted Ratings sheets not parsed
gaps.detail: Credit-rating history (agency, instrument, amount, rating, action, outlook) and non-accepted ratings — 9/41 and 2/41 companies. Material to a BFSI view.

gaps.title: Legal Cases - Financial Dispute sheet not parsed
gaps.detail: Money-claim disputes with amount-under-default + verdict — 12/41 companies. Separate register from Legal History; directly material to a lender.
gaps.fix: New FinancialDisputeCase entity + parser (flat 10-col table) + Litigation-tab section.

gaps.title: GstRegistration.CancellationDate is vestigial — no matching source column
gaps.detail: A6/#37 review (Codex, PR #87): the real GST sheet (16 cols, verified against the COASTAL fixture) has no CANCELLATION DATE column at all, so GstParser never sets this field. Not a dropped column — the entity property doesn't correspond to any real source data.
gaps.fix: Either remove the unused CancellationDate property, or confirm against a wider company sample whether any real GST sheet ever carries a cancellation date and parse it if so.

gaps.title: Auditors' Comments detail-table columns dropped
gaps.detail: A7/#38 discovery: the sheet's second stacked table (Serial Number | Financial Year | Section | Section Name | Auditors' Comments | Directors' Comments | Footnotes — see AuditorsParser's own doc comment) only reads Financial Year and Auditors' Comments (-> ObservationText). Serial Number, Section (a numeric code, e.g. 700600), Section Name, Directors' Comments, and Footnotes are read nowhere.
gaps.fix: Decide whether Directors' Comments / Section Name are worth a dedicated field on AuditorObservation, or explicitly dropped-by-design (Section is a redundant numeric code for Section Name; Serial Number/Footnotes look structural).

gaps.title: CompanyProfile.LastAgmDate / LeiStatus never rendered
gaps.detail: Found by render audit 2026-09-12: both fields are parsed and stored (LastAgmDate since A1/#32, LeiStatus alongside Lei). Lei itself renders in the fixed page header; LastAgmDate and LeiStatus render nowhere — not the Corporate tab, not the dossier PDF.
gaps.fix: Add both to the Corporate tab About section (and/or the page header alongside Lei).

gaps.title: Directors table drops DesignationAppointmentDate and Flags
gaps.detail: Found by render audit 2026-09-12: _DirectorTable.cshtml (shared by Current/Former Directors) has 5 columns (Name/DIN/Designation/Appointed/Ceased) — OriginalAppointmentDate renders as 'Appointed' but DesignationAppointmentDate (the present designation's own start date) has no column. Flags is captured and feeds the I5 analytics metric's count, but the flag text itself is never shown — a reviewer can see a count of flagged directors but not which director or why.
gaps.fix: Add both columns to _DirectorTable.cshtml.

gaps.title: Other Directorships: Date of Incorp / Active Compliance not rendered
gaps.detail: Found by render audit 2026-09-12: DateOfIncorporation and ActiveCompliance are captured on DirectorAssociation but the Other Directorships table has no column for either. (Initial audit also flagged 'Obligation Of Contribution' as unparsed — verified 2026-09-12 against the real roc.xls header that this is a false alarm: it's one combined column with Paid Up Capital, not a separate field, and is already captured correctly.)
gaps.fix: Add DateOfIncorporation/ActiveCompliance columns to the Other Directorships table.

gaps.title: Shareholding (>5% sheet fields): Location / PUC / Sum of Charges / Date of Incorp not rendered
gaps.detail: Found by render audit 2026-09-12: the Corporate → Ownership Shareholders table renders RelationshipRaw/ShareholderType/CompanyStatus/ActiveCompliance/Remarks (folded into existing columns) but has no columns for Location, PaidUpCapitalCrore, SumOfChargesCrore, or DateOfIncorporation — all captured on the Shareholding entity. (Initial audit's 'Obligation Of Contribution not parsed' claim was a false alarm — see G21.)
gaps.fix: Add the four missing columns to the Shareholders table.

gaps.title: RelatedCorporate: FinancialYearEnding / DateOfIncorporation not rendered
gaps.detail: Found by render audit 2026-09-12: the Corporate → Group Entities table has no column for FinancialYearEnding or DateOfIncorporation, both captured on RelatedCorporate. FinancialYearEnding matters in particular — two rows for the same related entity across different FYs currently look identical. (Initial audit's 'Obligation Of Contribution not parsed' claim was a false alarm — see G21.)
gaps.fix: Add FinancialYearEnding/DateOfIncorporation columns to the table.

gaps.title: GstRegistration: TaxpayerType / TradeName / NatureOfBusinessActivities / Flags not rendered
gaps.detail: Found by render audit 2026-09-12: all four are captured on GstRegistration but the Compliance → GST Registrations table has no columns for them. Flags feeds the G6 analytics metric's boolean count, but a reviewer has no way to see what a given GSTIN's flag actually says.
gaps.fix: Add the four columns to the GST Registrations table on _ComplianceTab.cshtml.

gaps.title: EpfoContribution: PaymentDate / PaymentDueDate not rendered per row
gaps.detail: Found by render audit 2026-09-12: both are captured and drive the H1 (on-time rate) / H2 (late-remittance count) analytics metrics internally, but the Compliance → EPFO Contribution & Headcount History table shows only the derived PaymentStatus text — a reviewer can't verify an individual 'late' classification by eye without the actual due/paid dates.
gaps.fix: Add PaymentDate/PaymentDueDate columns to the Contribution & Headcount History table.

take: Per-tab CONTENTS jump-nav on the long/mega tabs
'Reference Document(s)' provenance rows — link each data block to the exact MCA form + underlying PDFs (we have DocumentChunk/RequestDocument)
Explicit degenerate-state text — when Review Priority gates off (CORP_FINANCIAL_DATA_STALE etc.) name the reason, like the benchmark tool's 'score not available because 1..5'
Colour as a data signal — green (satisfied/valid/active), red (ceased/invalid/attention), amber (modification)
Inline annotations — 'OLD BANK (now NEW BANK)', 'UNKNOWN CHARGE HOLDER', invalid email in red
Charge Details as a grouped table with inline [+] expand (alternative/complement to the existing drawer)
Peer Comparison actual(black) vs median(orange) paired columns + 5-closest-peers horizontal bar
Split Pending / Disposed as sub-sections rather than a status column
Per-section unit scaler: Crore / Lakh / INR (NOT Million)
Multi-select -> 'Request a Zip' on the documents list
Consistent 'As per our records, X has no Y' empty states
The 4 provenance timestamps in the fixed company header ('Unlocked on' / 'Last updated N days ago')
Full shareholding-pattern category grid (G3) — the benchmark tool shows it, we drop it
leave: 0-100 / 1-5 numeric score or gauge — keep the deterministic Review Priority + flag strip. the benchmark tool's own score is null for a distressed company anyway.
No synthesis at all — our AI Analysis tab / Section 1 / 5-slot summary is the product; the benchmark tool has none
Download-only documents with no in-app viewer — we build the split-screen PDF reader (real differentiator)
Disclaimer paragraph on every page — once is enough
The 200-page undifferentiated data-dump feel of their PDF export
Data sourced beyond the MCA/ROC Excel (RBI publishing lists, SMTP email validation, phone-carrier lookup, website scraping) — out of scope now; note for later
